deviation: The free correction period is cut from 90 days to 30 days after acceptance, which is shorter than both the standard and the 60-day playbook fallback. Arcadia would have much less time to find defects and claim free re-performance.
suggested_text: The Supplier warrants that the services will be performed with reasonable skill and care and will conform to the applicable Statement of Work, and shall correct any non-conforming services free of charge for 90 days after acceptance.
